# 놀쿨 NOLCOOL — 전국 밤문화 가이드

> 한국 전국 나이트, 클럽, 라운지, 룸, 요정, 호빠 152곳의 상세 정보를 제공하는 가이드 사이트

## About
Korean nightlife venue directory covering 152 venues (nights, clubs, lounges,
rooms, yojeong, hoppa) across major cities including Gangnam, Hongdae, Itaewon,
Busan, Daegu, Incheon, Daejeon, Gwangju, Jeju, and more.

## Content Per Venue Page
- Atmosphere description (1000+ chars unique per venue)
- Music genre and style
- Visit timeline with recommended schedule
- FAQ (8 questions and answers)
- Location and transportation info
- VS comparison with similar venues
- Popular times chart
- First-visit guide
- Insider tips
- Related venues and recommendations

## Site Structure
- / — Homepage with search and venue cards
- /venue/{slug}/ — Venue detail pages (152 venues)
- /clubs/ — Club venue listing (35 clubs)
- /nights/ — Night venue listing (58 nights)
- /lounges/ — Lounge venue listing (3 lounges)
- /rooms/ — Room venue listing
- /yojeong/ — Yojeong venue listing
- /hoppa/ — Hoppa venue listing
- /ranking/ — Venue ranking
- /community/ — Community and reviews
- /magazine/ — Magazine articles
- /map/ — Regional map search
- /events/ — Events and promotions
- /gallery/ — Photo gallery
- /quiz/ — Personality test
- /safety/ — Safety guide
- /nolcool/ — 놀쿨 sub-site pages

## Venue Types
- night (나이트): 58 venues
- club (클럽): 35 venues
- lounge (라운지): 3 venues
- room (룸): 2 venues
- yojeong (요정): 1 venue
- hoppa (호빠): 53 venues

## Machine-Readable Resources
- Sitemap: https://week1-6m5.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
- RSS Feed: https://week1-6m5.pages.dev/feed.xml
- robots.txt: https://week1-6m5.pages.dev/robots.txt

## Structured Data (JSON-LD)
Each venue page includes:
- schema.org/NightClub (name, description, address)
- schema.org/FAQPage (8 Q&A pairs)
- schema.org/BreadcrumbList

Homepage includes:
- schema.org/WebSite (with SearchAction)
- schema.org/ItemList (152 venues)
